description: The figure-eight (az-figure-eight/orbit.json) over one period on its own sync interval T/32 at η = 0.001, Aarseth–Zare + RK4 under the step control in force (integrator contract Part 2b, Part 6's per-step rule) with the landing clamp, secant and bisection, the state landing on each boundary with its clock and no landing tolerance (R-998): its closure within REQ-INT-114's threshold, and its convergence order over the η ladder against a run at η = 1e-4, fitted by least squares on ln(error) against ln(η), within 0.5 of RK4's order 4 (REQ-INT-049, REQ-INT-119; R-927; the criterion written before any run, R-649).
